products.name: BrandPulse
products.published_open_results: Selected public articles and presentations only
products.limitations: Main panel Russian cities 100k+, age 14–64; other groups offered separately. Includes >420 categories; no full free market-level dataset verified.

products.name: Cross Web
products.published_open_results: Public rankings and dashboard of selected resources
products.limitations: National online audience 12+, mobile/desktop; scope, device, time and period must be recorded. Public dashboard not verified for programmatic access.

products.name: Share of Search / Поисковые запросы
products.limitations: Search interest != purchases, buyer counts or market revenue; cannot infer sales directly.

products.name: TV Index
products.limitations: Must track target audience, geography, period and metric denominator; coverage differs from Cross Web.

products.name: Radio Index
products.limitations: Large-city and overall study populations differ; not equivalent to all-Russia population coverage.

products.name: NRS / Press
products.limitations: NRS target audience and geography specified by the release.

products.name: Advertising monitoring
products.published_open_results: Only separate official news and descriptions
products.limitations: Do not treat ad presence as spending/sales absent explicit confirmed metric.

products.name: Public presentations and research archive
products.published_open_results: Open presentation index and selected published PDFs
products.limitations: Each statistic needs exact slide/page, field definition, date, sample and source. Do not bulk reproduce protected content without consent.

products.name: Metric methodology / glossary
products.limitations: Metric definition documentation; no quantitative series.

products.name: Specialized audience / partner measurement products
products.limitations: Need a project-specific scope/eligibility check before claiming datasets available.

access_summary.public_open: Official presentation PDFs and articles; selected media ratings; internet audience dashboard displays selected results.
access_summary.not_verified: Free registered account/tier for Mediascope Delivery API; public anonymous documented endpoints; bulk export permission for free dashboard.
access_summary.client_licensed: Cross Web UI/Delivery API; BrandPulse panels; detailed media indexes, search share and advertising monitoring.
access_summary.api_code_public: Python code in official GitHub is open to read and use subject to repository license; data access is separate.
access_summary.api_credential_source: Mediascope account managers per official repository README
access_summary.public_dashboard_browser_test: The referenced webindex.mediascope.net dashboard returned HTTP 502 in the web research tool; cannot validate export or API from this observation.
access_summary.copyright_note: Mediascope copyright page: reproduction of materials requires written permission. Responsibility page prohibits commercial distribution/change/transfer to third parties absent written permission. Attribution is also required for web publication.

suggested_use_modes.contents: Metadata, official links, project names, metric definitions, territorial coverage, time scope, access restrictions
Brief factual findings from publicly published official sources with exact citations, in line with copyright terms
Delivery API analysis, client reports, branded segments, raw series
